neighbours.label: scientific-study context: researchers set up to study or test something ('allows scientists to study the causes of X'), as against the same sentence frames about non-research activity
fire: The funding lets biologists study the spread of the virus in bats.
The new lab will allow researchers to study how the drug affects rats.
A grant enables geneticists to study the origins of the mutation in fish.
The trial lets doctors study the effects of the vaccine in older adults.
This project allows ecologists to study the decline of bees in cities.
The facility helps investigators study the causes of the infection in pigs.
The scholarship lets students study the behavior of the protein in yeast.
Their device allows chemists to study the breakdown of plastics in seawater.
quiet: The funding lets families buy food for the winter months.
The new hall will allow musicians to rehearse before the concert.
A grant enables the town to repair the old bridge over the river.
The voucher lets shoppers buy shoes at half price in December.
This project allows volunteers to plant flowers in the city parks.
The facility helps travelers store luggage during the layover.
The scholarship lets students travel abroad for a summer.
Their app allows drivers to find parking near the stadium.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.5 in sentences about scientists studying/testing; matched non-research frames below 0.05
notes: Card: ' study'/'Studie'/' testing'/' to' in research contexts.
